findings: Uses existing ChooseTargets/ChooseOption/ChooseColor decision DTOs and ordinary SubmitDecision actions; no new client action/type/event.
Aura host and attacking defender legal ids remain existing public objects; non-targeting behavior emits no targeting events.
Defender choice retains one indexed multi-token question; existing ChooseTargetsUI walks requirements and submits all slots together.
Off-state entrant ids are absent from client cards: DecisionContextCards safely omits preview, ChooseOption uses explicit sourceName, color UI uses prompt; no phantom battlefield card is sent.
Printed mode icons/options still come from existing PermanentEntryReplacements; controller/opponent chooser routing remains the shared implementation.
An actual running-client flow remains a gate for complete player-facing admission; static tracing alone is not browser evidence.
